REPORT:
Upon inspection, it was found that the automatic gate system for the carpark at Kings Living complex has suffered extensive water damage. The damage has caused a short circuit within the electronic control system, resulting in the motor windings and control board being fused and beyond repair.

Due to the extent of the water ingress and electrical failure , the entire automation system for both the sliding and swing gate combination must be replaceable. The existing components are irreparable and no longer safe or reliable for continued operation.

Recommended works were to remove all damaged equipment and the supply and installation of a new completed gate automation system, including control unit and motors.
